hero.title:
Run your school.
No paperwork, no stress.
hero.subtitle: ScolaGest is the all-in-one platform for schools: enrollment, report cards, payments and scheduling, all in one secure workspace.
hero.trust: No credit card required · 14-day free trial · Data isolated per school

features.title: Everything your school needs
features.subtitle: Built for the realities of schools in Guinea.
features.item1Desc: Enrollment, attendance, full records and student ID cards for every student.
features.item2Desc: Generate report cards with your school's logo, ready to print as PDF.
features.item3Desc: Record tuition payments, generate receipts, and track outstanding balances in real time.
features.item4Desc: Plan classes by grade and teacher, with no time conflicts.
features.item5Desc: Revenue, active students, outstanding balances — all your data at a glance.
features.item6Desc: Your school's data is strictly separated from every other school's.
